note: Produced with the openssl command line, not with sigillo code:
openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519, then openssl pkeyutl -sign -rawin over digest_hex.
Ed25519 is deterministic, so signature_base64 is the only correct answer for this key
and this digest. That is what makes this vector worth having: an implementation that
signs the wrong bytes cannot reproduce it.
